name: AMAL-C platform, Gulf of Suez, Egypt
description: 23 m water depth; 4-leg jacket with 2 inner conductors; 6 m x 6 m well configuration; four 30-inch conductors through legs plus two additional central conductors; four skirt piles; helideck; small accommodation module; local power generation with two diesel generators (one emergency back-up); test separator; bridge link to AMAL-B; well stream exported by 10-inch pipeline.
